newsitem.title: UK: Argentina's Mendoza expected to issue dollar bonds.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Mendoza expected to issue dollar bonds.

text.p: Argentina's province of Mendoza is expected to launch a two-tranche dollar bond in mid August, bankers said on Thursday.
The deal is expected to total $250 million with five-year and 10-year tranches.
CSFB and BankBoston are joint lead managers of the transaction.
Investor presentations are expected to take place in Buenos Aires, Boston, London, New York and Zurich.
This is an unsecured bond, bankers said.
In August last year, Mendoza launched a $150 million July 2002 bond to yield 403 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes and paid a 10.0 percent coupon.
The bond was secured by oil production royalties.
